svg.title: Nezahualcoyotl: Tlaloc mask
svg.desc: Period motif. A simplified rain-god mask with ringed eyes, a nose bar, curled upper lip and prominent fangs, based on a Mixtec Tlaloc mask dated 1325–1521. This is a broader Mesoamerican cultural emblem for Texcoco, not a documented standard of Nezahualcoyotl. Colors follow the game palette, with darker banner ink where needed for contrast; not historical flag colors.
